Frequently asked questions

Before you decide

What language is the collection in?

This UK offer is for the English edition of the collection.

Are the patterns physically posted to me?

No. This is a digital PDF product designed for home or print-shop printing on A4 paper.

Will mine look exactly like the photo?

The patterns reproduce the style and proportions of the scene. Felt colours, stitching, stuffing and handmade finishing can naturally create small differences.

Do I need to resize the patterns?

No. The patterns are designed at full size for A4 printing. Print at 100% rather than using “fit to page”.

I have never sewn felt before. Can I do this?

Yes. The projects use simple hand sewing, and the visual guides show joining, stuffing and finishing. A sewing machine is not required.

Are video lessons included?

No. The collection is PDF-based: patterns plus visual guides, ideal if you prefer to print and work at your own pace.

Are physical materials included?

No. Felt, thread, stuffing and accessories are purchased separately. The guides include materials information to help you prepare.

Is there still time to make it before Christmas?

The earlier you start, the more relaxed the process can be. Make one piece at a time at your own pace until the scene is complete.

Does it work on mobile?

The PDFs are designed to open on phone, tablet or computer. For sewing, many people prefer printing the pattern pages on A4 paper.

How does the guarantee work?

You can request a refund within 7 days of purchase if the collection is not what you expected.
